implementation: Original inline SVG and CSS; no exported SF Symbols asset, proprietary API, added package, canvas, or external image dependency.

sources.reference: Draw presets demonstrate a deliberate path reveal and ordered layers. NAVA translates that motion principle to a custom web vector.
Bounce provides a brief scaling effect. The custom mark settles with one small overshoot, without looping.
Feedback motion should be brief, precise and optional; it must not force a wait before the next action.
Decorative motion is removed when the system requests reduced motion.

behavior: Mount once on the real success state. A 64px fixed box keeps layout stable. Text and actions are available immediately. Four local accent marks fade away; no confetti, dimming, or recurring animation.
reducedMotion: Final static mark with complete check path and no accents, via prefers-reduced-motion. animated=false also opts out explicitly.
